in_marathi.name: Bhure
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhure हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhure is derived from Sanskrit, which means 'Lord of Cows'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as the protector of cows. The name Bhure is a symbol of compassion, love, and nurturing, representing the divine caretaker.
